headline: Davis Cup Sits Out On test4's Sofa
deck: test4 benched Davis, who returned a goal and two assists in 90 minutes
body:
The cruellest seat in the league belonged to Davis this week, planted on test4's bench while turning in a goal and two assists across the full ninety. A defender doing forward's work, and doing it for nobody who could count it.

test31121 managed the double insult. Yalcouyé took a goal and a clean sheet in 64 minutes, Gvardiol an assist and a clean sheet across the ninety, and both watched the round from the wrong side of the line. Two defenders working overtime, neither of them permitted to matter.

test211 left out Muharemović, who supplied an assist and kept his side tidy for ninety minutes. And 123, who saw Groß carry the load elsewhere, sat Donnarumma for a clean sheet and three saves. The goalkeeper did everything asked of him. Nobody asked.
